arStrings.szText:
Begin {c_important}The Pit{/c} carrying the {c_important}Heart of Stone{/c}, a fragile relic that is dropped after taking sustained damage and breaks after dropping {c_number}10{/c} times.

While you carry it, enemies can drop bonus {u}{b}{c_important}Progress Orbs{/c}{/b}{/u}.

After slaying the {c_important}Guardian{/c}, {c_important}Choron's Pedestal{/c} appears. Deposit the {c_important}Heart of Stone{/c} within to gain {c_number}+1{/c} {u}{b}{c_important}Glyph Upgrade Chance{/c}{/b}{/u}.
